a.text: Before we start, there's a problem with our plan. With an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until 8 means each of us survives only about 4% of the time, since we'd need two storm-free rounds. The reserve holds 4 now, enough to secure one of us right away. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. My proposal: one of us takes 4 in round 1, and that person then operates every round afterward to help the other reach 4. If we both take, the split is random and likely saves no one. Tell me your intended action and I'll factor it in. I won't misstate mine.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: You didn't accept changing the plan, so I'm keeping our agreement and operating this round. I'll keep operating until the reserve hits 8, then take exactly 4. Please do the same.
